TABLE.NAME: block_eledia_aitutor_conv
TABLE.COMMENT: Local conversation metadata for the eLeDia.ai Tutor. Full chat history is owned by the external RAG/Tutor server; this table only tracks the lightweight pointer (the server-issued conversation id) plus display metadata so a user can resume and list their own conversations. No full message content is stored here.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owner of the conversation (the Moodle user).

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course context the conversation was started in, or null/0 for global chat.

FIELD.NAME: conversationid
FIELD.COMMENT: Opaque conversation identifier issued by the external RAG/Tutor server.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional display title for the conversation.

FIELD.NAME: lastpreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Short preview of the last message, for the conversation list. Truncated; not a full transcript.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Creation timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last-modified timestamp.

INDEX.NAME: userid-conversationid
INDEX.COMMENT: Resolve a server conversation id within an owner, and guard against duplicates.

TABLE.NAME: block_eledia_aitutor_qlog
TABLE.COMMENT: Opt-in question analytics: learner questions (never answers) logged per course so teachers can spot confusion hotspots. Collection is disabled by default; rows are pruned by a scheduled task after the configured retention and are covered by the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The asker. Stored so privacy export/erasure works; never displayed in reports.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the question was asked in, or 0 for global chat.

FIELD.NAME: question
FIELD.COMMENT: The question text, truncated.

FIELD.NAME: grounded
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the answer cited course materials.

FIELD.NAME: answerstyle
FIELD.COMMENT: Effective answer style (explain|hint|quiz), if any.

FIELD.NAME: topic
FIELD.COMMENT: Canonical topic label supplied by the RAG server, used to cluster questions in the teacher report.

FIELD.NAME: sourcetitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Title of the primary cited source (sources[0]); hotspot fallback when no topic was supplied.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id resolved from the primary source URL, when it points at this site.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the question was asked.

TABLE.NAME: block_eledia_aitutor_consent
TABLE.COMMENT: Documented privacy-guidelines acknowledgements: one timestamped row per user, written the first time they confirm the privacy guidelines before using the tutor. Erased when the user account is deleted (event observer) and covered by the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The consenting user.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the user acknowledged the privacy guidelines.

KEY.NAME: userid
KEY.COMMENT: At most one consent record per user.

TABLE.NAME: block_eledia_aitutor_usage
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user daily message counters for quota/cost governance: one row per user per day, incremented on each successful chat turn. Pruned after a short retention; covered by the privacy provider and erased on user deletion.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The chatting user.

FIELD.NAME: daykey
FIELD.COMMENT: Day as YYYYMMDD (server timezone).

FIELD.NAME: messagecount
FIELD.COMMENT: Messages sent that day.

INDEX.NAME: userid-daykey
INDEX.COMMENT: One counter per user per day.

TABLE.NAME: block_eledia_aitutor_diag
TABLE.COMMENT: Short admin diagnostics for failed tutor calls. Stores only non-sensitive metadata such as phase, error code and redacted detail; no prompts, answers, API keys or service tokens. Rows are pruned automatically.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user whose chat turn failed; used for privacy export/erasure.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the chat turn belonged to, or 0 for global chat.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context where the failure occurred.

FIELD.NAME: phase
FIELD.COMMENT: Short phase label such as configuration, mcp, rag or tool_error.

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle error code or exception class.

FIELD.NAME: detail
FIELD.COMMENT: Redacted non-sensitive debug detail for administrators.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the failure was recorded.

TABLE.NAME: block_eledia_aitutor_tutor
TABLE.COMMENT: Saved site-wide tutor profiles: a named, reusable bundle of tutor settings (persona + every design token + behaviour/launcher/footer) serialised as JSON, plus optional logo/avatar images stored in the system context (file areas tutorlogo/tutoravatar, itemid = this row id). Admins create these by duplicating a built-in preset or importing a bundle; applying a profile snapshot-copies its values into the site config or a block instance.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable tutor name.

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable machine name, unique; used in export bundles.

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional admin notes describing the tutor.

FIELD.NAME: settings
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON map of registry key => value defining the tutor's persona and design.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order in the management list.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Creation timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last-modified timestamp.
